frameworks.name: Pyramid / Executive Summary
frameworks.description: Top-down structure starting with the main conclusion, followed by supporting arguments and evidence
frameworks.when_to_use: Opening slides, key recommendations, executive summaries, when audience needs the answer first
frameworks.layout_hint: Large headline with key message, 3-4 supporting points below, optional detail bullets

frameworks.name: Situation–Complication–Resolution
frameworks.description: Narrative structure: establish context, introduce tension, propose solution
frameworks.when_to_use: Problem statements, change management, persuasive arguments, strategy proposals
frameworks.layout_hint: Three distinct sections (columns or rows), visual flow from left to right

frameworks.name: 2x2 Matrix
frameworks.description: Four-quadrant framework for comparing options along two dimensions
frameworks.when_to_use: Strategic prioritization, portfolio analysis, decision frameworks, segmentation
frameworks.layout_hint: Equal quadrants with clear axis labels, items plotted with icons or text

frameworks.name: MECE Issue Tree
frameworks.description: Mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive breakdown of a problem or topic
frameworks.when_to_use: Problem decomposition, scope definition, root cause analysis, structuring complex topics
frameworks.layout_hint: Hierarchical tree from left to right, branches at each level
dont: Go deeper than 3 levels on one slide

frameworks.name: Value Chain
frameworks.description: Sequential process showing how value is created from inputs to outputs
frameworks.when_to_use: Operations analysis, competitive advantage, process improvement, margin analysis
frameworks.layout_hint: Horizontal chain with arrows, primary activities in main flow, support activities above/below

frameworks.name: Customer Journey
frameworks.description: Visualization of customer experience across touchpoints and stages
frameworks.when_to_use: CX improvement, service design, marketing strategy, pain point analysis
frameworks.layout_hint: Horizontal timeline with stages, touchpoints mapped, emotion curve optional

frameworks.name: Funnel
frameworks.description: Conversion visualization showing progressive narrowing through stages
frameworks.when_to_use: Sales pipeline, marketing conversion, process efficiency, drop-off analysis
frameworks.layout_hint: Inverted trapezoid shape, percentages at each stage, conversion rates between stages

frameworks.name: Timeline / Roadmap
frameworks.description: Temporal visualization of milestones, phases, or planned activities
frameworks.when_to_use: Project planning, strategic initiatives, historical context, implementation plans
frameworks.layout_hint: Horizontal timeline with milestones, phases in swim lanes if multiple workstreams

frameworks.name: Before-After-Bridge
frameworks.description: Transformation narrative: current state, future state, and how to get there
frameworks.when_to_use: Change proposals, transformation cases, improvement initiatives, sales pitches
frameworks.layout_hint: Three columns or sections: Before (pain), After (gain), Bridge (solution)

frameworks.name: Pros/Cons / Trade-off
frameworks.description: Balanced comparison of advantages and disadvantages or competing options
frameworks.when_to_use: Decision support, option evaluation, risk assessment, stakeholder alignment
frameworks.layout_hint: Two columns (pros/cons) or comparison table with options as columns

frameworks.name: Benchmark Table
frameworks.description: Comparative analysis against competitors, standards, or best practices
frameworks.when_to_use: Competitive analysis, performance gaps, best practice adoption, market positioning
frameworks.layout_hint: Table with entities as columns, criteria as rows, visual indicators for performance

frameworks.name: Waterfall / Gantt
frameworks.description: Project schedule visualization showing tasks, durations, and dependencies
frameworks.when_to_use: Project planning, resource allocation, timeline communication, progress tracking
frameworks.layout_hint: Tasks as rows, time as horizontal axis, bars showing duration, dependencies as arrows
dont: Use at wrong level of detail

frameworks.name: KPI Scorecard
frameworks.description: Dashboard view of key performance indicators with status and trends
frameworks.when_to_use: Performance reviews, executive updates, operational monitoring, goal tracking
frameworks.layout_hint: Grid of KPI cards with metric, target, actual, trend indicator, RAG status

frameworks.name: Heatmap
frameworks.description: Color-coded matrix showing intensity or performance across two dimensions
frameworks.when_to_use: Risk assessment, performance comparison, opportunity mapping, resource allocation
frameworks.layout_hint: Grid with color intensity indicating values, clear legend, labeled axes

frameworks.name: Porter 5 Forces
frameworks.description: Industry competitive analysis framework: rivalry, suppliers, buyers, substitutes, new entrants
frameworks.when_to_use: Industry analysis, competitive strategy, market entry decisions, strategic planning
frameworks.layout_hint: Pentagon or cross diagram with central rivalry, four forces around

frameworks.name: SWOT Analysis
frameworks.description: Four-quadrant analysis of Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats
frameworks.when_to_use: Strategic planning, situation assessment, when explicitly requested by stakeholders
frameworks.layout_hint: 2x2 grid with S/W on top, O/T on bottom; internal vs external distinction

frameworks.name: Logic Model
frameworks.description: Causal chain: Inputs → Activities → Outputs → Outcomes → Impact
frameworks.when_to_use: Program design, impact measurement, grant proposals, theory of change
frameworks.layout_hint: Horizontal flow with boxes for each stage, arrows showing causation

frameworks.name: Single Key Message
frameworks.description: Minimalist slide with one powerful statement or insight
frameworks.when_to_use: Transitions, emphasis points, memorable takeaways, chapter breaks
frameworks.layout_hint: Large centered text, minimal supporting elements, strong typography
do: Support with one visual if needed

frameworks.name: Data Visualization
frameworks.description: Chart-focused slide for presenting quantitative insights
frameworks.when_to_use: Trends, comparisons, distributions, when data tells the story
frameworks.layout_hint: Chart as hero element, clear title stating the insight, minimal supporting text
do: Title with the insight, not description

frameworks.name: Agenda / Table of Contents
frameworks.description: Overview slide showing presentation structure and sections
frameworks.when_to_use: Opening after title, long presentations, navigation aid
frameworks.layout_hint: Numbered list or visual map of sections, timing if relevant
do: Show where we are in the flow
